title: Vehicle breakdown
tldr: Move out of traffic if you safely can, switch on hazard lights and call roadside assistance or emergency services for immediate danger. Give your road, direction and nearest marker. On a high-speed road, follow local road-authority advice about whether to stay belted inside or exit to a protected area.
steps: Do not stand in travel lanes or between vehicles. Avoid repairs beside moving traffic.
Share the road name, direction, marker and number of people.
If fire, smoke or a collision threat makes the vehicle unsafe, move to a safe location away from traffic when possible.
Keep children and pets protected and conserve phone power. In remote areas do not wander without a known safe destination.
next: Carry water, weather protection, a charged phone and a vehicle kit. Check tires, fuel or charge before travel.
watch: Exit choices depend on the road and surroundings; do not apply one universal rule to every breakdown.
